content.title: Cross-Medium Travel Partners | Landmark Chapters and Synchronized Route
content.summary: A live adult botanist and a drawn adult mapmaker cross four landscape chapters through matched gestures and depth swaps. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.

quick_start.input_format: One clearly adult live-action identity and one clearly adult illustrated identity retain different media signatures throughout. + Every location change preserves paired travel direction and follows a visible shared transition carrier. + Each chapter contains one synchronized action that proves common timing and local geography. + Alternating foreground occlusion proves shared depth without merging faces, bodies or rendering media. + The terminal frame reunites both adults, one destination object and one exact original route title in a shared action.
quick_start.recommended_input: Pair one original live-action adult field botanist with a clearly two-dimensional adult mapmaker: the botanist has a red scarf and canvas satchel, while the illustrated companion has a navy bob, yellow coat and ink-hatched shadow. Use the moving disk as a wipe into a cliff path, covered market and salt-lake pier; at each chapter preserve both identities, rightward travel and one synchronized local action. At a hill observatory both turn, tap the same projected map and finish one side-by-side step beneath the exact original title "TWO MEDIA / ONE ROUTE".
required_anchors: One clearly adult live-action identity and one clearly adult illustrated identity retain different media signatures throughout.
Every location change preserves paired travel direction and follows a visible shared transition carrier.
Alternating foreground occlusion proves shared depth without merging faces, bodies or rendering media.
The terminal frame reunites both adults, one destination object and one exact original route title in a shared action.
usage_steps: Replace the example subject, setting, and surface details with an original concept.
Keep every required anchor and Creative DNA invariant causally visible.
Choose the MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 prompt and fill only the declared variable slots.
Check duration, event order, camera continuity, sound, and anti-copy constraints before generation.
applicable_scope: A live adult botanist and a drawn adult mapmaker cross four landscape chapters through matched gestures and depth swaps. Preserve the five causal invariants and terminal proof while replacing every source-specific surface.
Original 4–15 second concepts that can preserve every required anchor.
MiniMax H3 or Seedance 2.0 projects that need a reusable causal video structure.
not_suitable_for: Requests that copy the source identity, setting, props, dialogue, or shot order.
Concepts that cannot show all required anchors inside the target duration.
Long-form exposition or unrelated multi-location stories without a compact causal chain.

creative_dna.mechanism: 固定一名成年真人和一名成年二维原创旅伴，两者保持不同材质却共享方向、节拍与地标路线；每章由一次同步手势或步态证明同场，最终以共同动作结束而非互相替换。 The reusable mechanism preserves causal order, spatial anchors and the final proof while replacing every source-specific person, location, object, wording, choreography and design.

invariants.rule: One clearly adult live-action identity and one clearly adult illustrated identity retain different media signatures throughout.
invariants.purpose: Establishes the baseline identity, object or geography that every later state must preserve.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact baseline rule, later changes cannot be attributed to the same subject, object or place, so the sequence loses its reference state. Removed rule: "One clearly adult live-action identity and one clearly adult illustrated identity retain different media signatures throughout."

invariants.rule: Every location change preserves paired travel direction and follows a visible shared transition carrier.
invariants.purpose: Makes the visible trigger precede and explain the first mechanism response.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact trigger rule, the response appears spontaneously and the central cause-and-effect claim is no longer demonstrated. Removed rule: "Every location change preserves paired travel direction and follows a visible shared transition carrier."

invariants.rule: Each chapter contains one synchronized action that proves common timing and local geography.
invariants.purpose: Keeps the middle progression registered instead of allowing an unexplained reset.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact progression rule, the middle can jump to a replacement state and the accumulated result is no longer traceable. Removed rule: "Each chapter contains one synchronized action that proves common timing and local geography."

invariants.rule: Alternating foreground occlusion proves shared depth without merging faces, bodies or rendering media.
invariants.purpose: Reconnects the changed or partial state to the established subject and spatial anchor.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact reconnection rule, detail or transformed shots can belong to a different subject or geography and continuity cannot be verified. Removed rule: "Alternating foreground occlusion proves shared depth without merging faces, bodies or rendering media."

invariants.rule: The terminal frame reunites both adults, one destination object and one exact original route title in a shared action.
invariants.purpose: Turns the terminal hold into observable proof that the mechanism completed.
invariants.ablation_failure: Without this exact terminal-proof rule, the sequence stops on motion alone and never confirms the promised outcome or preserved aftermath. Removed rule: "The terminal frame reunites both adults, one destination object and one exact original route title in a shared action."

slots.constraint: An original hierarchy of diegetic cues; no unsupported source-audio claim.

all source words, logos, watermarks, typefaces and brand identifiers

the source palette, signature effects, prompt wording, creator handle and narrative particulars
